title: Universal Taxonomy for Article Classification
description: Hierarchical taxonomy with LLM-optimized classification hints. Used by TaxonomyClassifier to tag articles against a controlled vocabulary.

version.description: Taxonomy version. Change triggers re-classification of existing articles.

nodes.description: Top-level taxonomy nodes (areas). The classifier's coarse pass selects among these.

tag_sets.description: Orthogonal tag dimensions applied independently of the node tree. Key = dimension name (e.g., 'impact').

ordered_children_at_depth.description: Depths where children have semantic ordering (e.g., maturity levels). Empty = all unordered.

range_window.description: For ordered children: applicable range = primary ± this value.

children.description: Sub-nodes. Empty array or omitted = leaf node.

NodeHints.description: LLM-optimized classification hints. All fields are natural language, designed for direct prompt injection.

summary.description: What articles in this node are about. Used in coarse and fine pass prompts.

topics.description: Specific topics covered. Helps LLM recognize matching content.

not_this_node.description: Topics commonly confused with this node. Format: 'Topic — why it belongs elsewhere → correct_node'.

signals.description: Observable signals in article content that indicate this node.

boundary.description: When to classify at the parent level vs. this child node.
